description: This file defines a channel-agnostic status reaction controller for displaying agent status via message reactions, including types, constants, and functions for managing reaction emojis and timers.

methods.name: resolveToolEmoji
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate emoji for a given tool name based on predefined tokens.

methods.name: createStatusReactionController
methods.description: Creates a controller object to manage status reaction emojis with features like debouncing, timers, and state management.
